يقتفين (form VIII)
# يَقْتَفِينَ (yaqtafīna) /jaq.ta.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# يُقْتَفَيْنَ (yuqtafayna) /juq.ta.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
